grok.verdict: v6 checks out: the welded collar and hidden-skin cull stop skin poking through, both idle feet now plant flat and the file is down to 45.7 MB; next, fix the lumpy shorts and uneven hem, the collar lip line, and the smooth shell hair, and give the skin a subsurface look.

gemini.verdict: Approved: a far more natural face with the eyeliner and chest emblem gone, but it scores 26 because two claims are false (the manifest's skin/eye material values and the NOTES.md ripstop uniform with bronze-gold straps); correct the paperwork and give the suit real fabric detail.

hermes.verdict: Valid and fight-ready, but the renders show the camera inside a broken mesh, so there's almost nothing to judge. Fix the mesh and re-render.

me.verdict: Approved: the call-8 fit pass really tightens the rash guard and blends the lower-neck weights (clothing 4 to 5, total 39); next, fix the shiny pleated collar, the jagged neck edge under the jaw, the hip split in the shorts and the tiptoe stance feet, and correct the '13 mm at hems' wording.

muse.verdict: Approved: a clean, honestly documented build of the stock Kachujin character with all 30 required clips plus the 3 optional ones and non-metallic materials, but it is still a game-resolution character with poreless skin, painted eyes and sculpted hair, so realism sits at 40.
